⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Self-Employed Pathway Modernisation

Real-time HMRC self-assessment integration. Automated Class 2 NI verification. Reduce claim processing from 24 days to 48 hours. New business exemption digitisation. Target 90% automated approval.

2. NI Credit Protection

100% automatic Class 1/2 credit assignment during MA. Zero gap in NI record. State Pension forecast real-time integration. Legacy HRP conversion automation. Target zero missed credits by 2028.

3. SPL Digital Integration

End-to-end SPL from MA digital pathway. Split-block calculator. Employer notification automation. Mixed leave guidance. Reduce SPL opt-in friction by 80%. Target 40% uptake by 2029.

4. Take-Up Maximisation

Close the 28% MA take-up gap. Universal Credit integration prompts. HMRC employer notification trigger. Self-employed outreach via tax return. Refugee and asylum seeker pathway. Target 95% take-up.

5. Counter-Fraud Without Punitive Culture

HMRC real-time NI verification. Employment status AI. Self-employment trading evidence. Proportionate investigation. Dignity-first compliance. No blanket sanctions on new mothers.

6. Employer Digital Integration

HMRC RTI auto-employment verification. SMP/MA eligibility auto-routing. Employer notification digitisation. Redundancy protection tracking. Return-to-work guarantee digital confirmation.

7. Health & Social Care Bridge

Antenatal appointment digital tracking. NHS perinatal mental health referral. Health visitor integration. Stillbirth bereavement fast-track. Domestic abuse safeguarding trigger. Substance misuse support pathway.

8. Cross-Scheme Family Intelligence

Single family record across MA/UC/SPL/CB/TFC. Auto-eligibility cascade from MA claim. No mother navigating 5 systems. Single digital family identity. Joined-up family support from pregnancy.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No mother denied Maternity Allowance without verified NI contribution check and face-to-face claim option
  • ❌ No NI credit gap created during maternity period — every claimant receives Class 1/2 credits automatically
  • ❌ No self-employed mother penalised for HMRC processing delays — late claim tolerance of 6 months minimum
  • ❌ No SPL opt-in blocked by employer non-compliance — DWP direct enforcement pathway
  • ❌ No fraud investigation of new mothers without risk-scored evidence threshold and dignity protocol
  • ❌ No overpayment recovery applied during the 39-week payment period without hardship assessment

4
Scale: Roll out across all MA operations nationally. Integrate with HMRC Digital and UC platform. Deploy across DLA/PIP maternity interactions. Employer digital integration.

Assure: Continuous audit-grade MA governance reporting. Take-up transparency. Parliamentary evidence generation. Maternal employment impact metrics. NI protection verification.
